subject.title: fix: stop selected channel sessions from WebChat

question: Should a Control UI stop for a selected non-global channel session permanently discard that session's followup and lane queues, rather than aborting only the currently active run?
rationale: This is an intentional user-visible cancellation semantic exposed through the Gateway protocol; tests can prove either behavior but cannot choose the long-term product contract.

options.title: Adopt selected-session queue clearing
options.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` for Control UI selected non-global stops so an already queued successor cannot restart after the visible run stops.

options.title: Abort active work only
options.body: Keep the existing queue-preserving stop meaning and revise the UI/Gateway path so queued followups remain eligible to run.

options.title: Split the semantics
options.body: Keep stop queue-preserving by default and introduce an explicitly labeled destructive cancellation action after product design review.

recommendation.title: Adopt selected-session queue clearing
recommendation.body: Accept `clearQueued: true` for Control UI selected non-global stops so an already queued successor cannot restart after the visible run stops.

likelyOwner.reason: Best available routing candidate for a repository-level Gateway/session behavior decision; concrete file-history ownership was not established from the supplied read-only context.
